body:
## Change

F1. Cancel non-success/redirected install response bodies before returning CONTENT_NETWORK_FAILED. Match existing sanitized cancellation handling for read failures.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral red/green asserts HTTP503 open-stream cancellation. Parent inspected fetch/read cleanup paths and reran regression. Worker install suite: 68; boundaries: 52 passed. Typecheck, targeted lint/format and diff checks pass.

## Limits

L1. WHATWG Response/ReadableStream fixture, not real Chromium network transport. No live install/acquisition. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(content): cancel rejected install responses
